sections.body: Germs are tiny. Too tiny to see! 🦠
Soap and water wash germs away. 🧼💧
Rub, rub, rub! Fronts, backs and between fingers. Sing 'Happy Birthday' two times while you rub.
Show a grown-up how you wash your hands.
Washing with soap for about 20 seconds (two rounds of 'Happy Birthday') helps remove germs. Key times: before eating, after the toilet, after playing outside and after touching animals.

quiz.q: When should we wash our hands?
hints: Germs on hands can get into our mouth.
When do our hands touch our food?
We brush teeth before bed so they stay clean. When do we wash hands so food stays clean?
quiz.explain: Yes! We wash before eating so germs don't get into our tummy. 🧼

hints: What makes bubbles at the sink?
It is slippery and smells nice.
When a plate is dirty, we wash it with water and something bubbly. Hands are the same!
quiz.explain: Soap and water wash germs away! 💧
